Sometime after the [[Clone Wars]] and during its [[Imperial Era|reign]], the [[Galactic Empire]] began a '''subjugation''' of the [[Anoat sector]] during its expansion into the [[Outer Rim Territories]] under the guise of [[Galactic Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Sheev Palpatine]] who had little tolerance for the [[Noble Court]] independence, and issued a number of [[Death|kill]] orders on the [[noble]]s and took control over their domain.<ref name="Uprising" />
